AgentRegistryEntry.description:
One ``[[agents]]`` entry of an ``agents.toml`` registry: a launchable agent.

Keys this model does not name are ignored, so an SDK may add its own (the TypeScript SDK's
``agent`` reference).

schema.description: The agent's schema document (`temporal-agent-harness schema`), relative to this file. Its init data becomes the agent's start interface.
schema.title: Schema
